scenario.summary: Gorbag is a Russia-aligned threat actor targeting Ukrainian law enforcement and defense sectors since 2025. They utilize spearphishing with macro-enabled spreadsheets or WinRAR exploits (CVE-2025-8088) to deploy BeautyStealer for rapid credential and file harvesting and Prime ReverseShell for command and control before performing self-deletion.

meta.rationale: Prioritize endpoints in the defense, law enforcement, and local administration sectors. Focus on hosts with identified vulnerabilities to CVE-2025-8088.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has deployed the Gorbag compromise chain by exploiting a WinRAR vulnerability or using macro-enabled lures to drop transient harvesters into ProgramData and establish startup folder persistence.

hunt.name: Gorbag APT Rapid Harvester Deployment
hunt.description: This hunt targets the initial deployment phase of the Russia-aligned Gorbag group. The actor uses spearphishing lures or weaponized archives exploiting CVE-2025-8088 to drop payloads like BeautyStealer or Prime ReverseShell. The hunt follows a phased approach: first, it identifies vulnerable hosts and examines the file surface for lure delivery and rare dropper activity in ProgramData; second, it corroborates these findings by looking for Startup folder persistence and PowerShell loader script blocks. This sequence allows an analyst to distinguish between routine file activity and the specific, multi-stage delivery pattern of an ephemeral intelligence harvester that removes itself after execution.

nodes.label: Identify hosts vulnerable to WinRAR traversal

config.content: SELECT device_uid, resource_uid, cve_uid, severity, title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE cve_uid = '{{cve_id}}' AND status != 'suppressed'
config.description: Find endpoints currently reporting the WinRAR vulnerability (CVE-2025-8088) to prioritize the behavioral hunt.
config.expected_signal: Rows identify devices with vulnerable versions of WinRAR. Silence means the specific vulnerability was not detected by scanners in this estate.

primitive_config.label: Identify hosts vulnerable to WinRAR traversal
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_uid, resource_uid, cve_uid, severity, title FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE cve_uid = '{{cve_id}}' AND status != 'suppressed'
primitive_config.expected: Rows identify devices with vulnerable versions of WinRAR. Silence means the specific vulnerability was not detected by scanners in this estate.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lure_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Match the exact filenames used in the Gorbag campaign in recent file activity.
config.expected_signal: A file matching a lure name landing on a host. Silence means these specific file names were not observed.

primitive_config.label: Detection of specific spearphishing lures
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{lure_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A file matching a lure name landing on a host. Silence means these specific file names were not observed.

nodes.label: Rare file drops in ProgramData from suspect parents

config.content: SELECT LOWER(file_name) AS dropped_file, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%excel.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%winrar.exe') AND LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\programdata\%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dropped_file, process_name HAVING hosts <= 3
config.description: Identify behavioral indicators where Excel or WinRAR drop rare files into the ProgramData directory.
config.expected_signal: A rare file created in ProgramData by a productivity or archiving application. Silence suggests no such drops occurred within the window.

primitive_config.label: Rare file drops in ProgramData from suspect parents
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(file_name) AS dropped_file, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%excel.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%winrar.exe') AND LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\programdata\%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dropped_file, process_name HAVING hosts <= 3
primitive_config.expected: A rare file created in ProgramData by a productivity or archiving application. Silence suggests no such drops occurred within the window.

config.objective: Decide whether any host shows evidence of a successful Gorbag delivery based on lure file presence or anomalous ProgramData dropper behavior.
config.description: Analyze whether the initial delivery evidence from lures and rare drops warrants a follow-on persistence check.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on whether delivery activity is suspicious on a per-host basis.
config.success_criteria: A suspicious/malicious verdict if specific lures are found or if Office/WinRAR drop rare payloads on vulnerable hosts.

nodes.label: Creation of Startup folder LNK files

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_name, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\start menu\programs\startup\%' AND LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.lnk' AND (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%winrar.exe' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%powershell.exe') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify persistence established via the Windows Startup folder, dropped by WinRAR or PowerShell.
config.expected_signal: A LNK file landing in the Startup directory. Silence is expected if the threat actor only performed one-time harvesting.
